image_description: A low-angle shot of a restaurant entrance featuring a large, arched sign with stylized text 'OMOO' above the doorway. Below the arch, several printed menu boards are displayed on stands or attached to the wall, showing lists of food items with images and prices. The scene includes hanging decorative light fixtures and architectural details like columns and a glass ceiling structure.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the main sign is stylized but slightly distorted. The letters are not perfectly formed standard fonts; they have a melted, organic quality typical of AI-generated signage where text is often approximated rather than rendered precisely.
The text on the menu boards is unnaturally blurry/smudged, lacking the sharp edges expected of printed text even at a distance. It resembles 'lorem ipsum' blobs rather than crisp characters.
The left hanging lamp has an irregular, asymmetrical shape that defies typical manufacturing symmetry. The glass/metal structure looks slightly warped and inconsistent with rigid physical materials.

To verify the spatial relationship between the hanging sign, the archway, and the menu boards, ensuring no floating elements or depth bleeding.

Physical plausibility of the hanging light fixtures
